justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: RHIT holders concentrate in hospital HIM and payer coding departments; movement into EHR vendor or digital-health product roles is uncommon without additional credentials.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Epic, Oracle Health, and digital-health employers rarely list RHIT in postings, preferring RHIA, CPHIMS, or clinical informatics backgrounds.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Median medical records specialist pay (~$48K) is materially below experienced PT/OT clinical wages, producing a negative premium for rehab clinicians.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Curriculum covers ICD-10/CPT coding, data integrity, and HIM workflows but lacks SQL, data science, or build-level EHR configuration depth.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Provides HIM/coding vocabulary useful for documentation and revenue-cycle roles, but does not leverage rehab clinical expertise as a differentiator.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Requires an accredited associate degree or equivalent HIM coursework plus exam fee — moderate time/cost burden, higher than a short course but lower than a master's.
